description: All three windows listen for events and none is given anything else. The pill calls nothing at all — see the contract at the top of app/ui/pill.js; it only listens, for its state, its levels and its theme. The first-run and settings windows call commands this app defines itself (`start_download`, `hotkey_label`, `settings_get`, `settings_set`), which need no permission here because self-defined commands are not gated by capabilities; only core and plugin ones are.
